about_short_description.short_description: Emerge is a suite of developer tools designed to supercharge mobile apps and the teams that build them.

product.name: Size Analysis
product.description: A tool to monitor and reduce mobile app size by tracking size changes, providing automated insights, and benchmarking against competitors.

product.name: Snapshots
product.description: A snapshot testing tool that detects visual regressions by automatically generating UI previews and comparing changes on pull requests.

product.name: Reaper
product.description: A dynamic runtime analysis tool that identifies and removes dead code based on production usage data.

product.name: Performance Analysis
product.description: A tool to continuously monitor and diagnose mobile app performance regressions, focusing on startup time and UI test performance.

product.name: Launch Booster
product.description: A tool that reduces mobile app startup time by optimizing app launch order using order files, integrated into the release process.

product.name: Build Distribution
product.description: A cross-platform service for distributing iOS and Android app builds to teams with easy installation and integration into CI/CD workflows.
